project.name: Kettlebridge
project.boundarySource: Resolved named-place location with a conservative strict settlement study buffer
project.researchNotes: Sequential place 3 of 15: every required category, all four named trail providers, local HES/NRHE completeness, dates, access, transport and dogs were checked before continuing. Kettlebridge Inn is excluded from the café-focused Eat list because its offer is a pub and full restaurant. Kingskettle and Balmalcolm attractions and facilities are not transferred.

touristAppeal.label: Minor Interest
touristAppeal.summary: Kettlebridge is a pleasant small village on published local walking circuits, but its inn is a full pub/restaurant and no café-led daytime stop, attraction or public visitor facility was verified.
touristAppeal.dogAccessSummary: Outdoor access can work for responsible dog visits; venue-specific policies are recorded individually.
